Method of Attack: Disguised as legitimate BleachBit utility to trick users into downloading
Harvests sensitive data including browser history, saved logins, stored credentials, desktop and text files
Uploads stolen data to attacker-controlled command and control servers
Attack Vector: Fake website impersonating official BleachBit site (bleachbitcleaner.com)
Download of ZIP archive from Dropbox
Execution of malicious binary mimicking BleachBit executable
